card.name: Hyphen after Y in infusion lines
card.fires_on: The hyphen or 'type' right after the letter Y in Y-connector or Y-type infusion set wording. It also fires weakly on small symbols or letters inside technical terms, such as the G in needle gauge or the β in beta-lactams.
